name: Creator Toolkit
description: Editor toolkit: Palette Lab (generate/apply palettes), duplicate cleaner with undo, object inspector, micro grid.

show-editor-button.name: Show editor toolbox button
show-editor-button.description: Adds the Creator Toolkit button to the level editor when the target menu is available.

confirm-optimization.name: Confirm optimization actions
confirm-optimization.description: Ask for confirmation before removing duplicates or snapping objects to the grid.

restore-grid-on-open.name: Restore saved grid step
restore-grid-on-open.description: Re-apply the last Micro Grid step when the editor opens.
